thread:
maria: Quick heads-up — postmortem follow-up: the delayed-token-ingest pattern reappeared for a small window (2024-09-10..09-12). billing-bot: Alert: detected 12 accounts with missing tokens, total delta ~72k tokens.
aj: Thanks. Can we confirm root cause?
maria: Initial analysis points to write-throttling on the metering DB during the 02:00UTC nightly compaction window — writes queued and some batches dropped.
sophie: I'll take ownership of immediate remediation/backfill. Plan is: re-run the failed ingest batches, reconcile ledger, then create invoice adjustments if needed. ETA Tue EOD.
ops-lead: Appreciate it — Sophie, please add acceptance criteria + rollback plan. Also add who will notify customers for any >$500 credit.
sophie: Will do. Quick checklist I'm adding to the postmortem doc: 1) queue backfill job 2) run reconcile script 3) apply credits or reissue invoices 4) confirm with finance.
aj: Link the postmortem doc here when done. Acceptance criteria = ledger parity + audit trail + tickets for any manual credits.
maria: I'll own customer comms for impacted enterprise accounts. Draft to Sales & Support by Wed AM.
billing-bot: Backfill job queued: job_id=bf-7823 status=pending region=eu-west.
sophie: Note — there's an infra fix (missing DB index) to prevent compaction contention. PR in review: https://git.redwood/infra/pr/2345. Needs infra sign-off before production runs.
ops-lead: If PR blocks, can we run backfills in smaller batches to avoid compaction window?
sophie: Yes — we'll run in 15-min chunks and monitor token-commit latency. Command I'll run:
```
./tools/backfill --job bf-7823 --chunk-size 15m --dry-run
```
then remove --dry-run after a sanity pass.
dan: Who's doing the final ledger verification? happy to run the reconciliation checks if Sophie wants.
sophie: Thanks Dan — can you run the reconciliation after my backfill completes? I'll ping with job_id and expected delta.
aj: Please add timeline & owners to the incident tracker: https://redwood.internal/incidents/pm-459 and assign remediation label. Also flag as "recurring pattern" so SRE schedules a deeper follow-up.
maria: Short-term timeline recap: Sophie (backfill) ETA Tue EOD, Dan (reconcile) ETA Wed AM, Maria (customer comms) Wed AM.
ops-lead: Good. Long-term owner for recurrence prevention = infra/SRE. Assigning to @ops-lead for coordination.
sophie: posting final runbook steps in the postmortem doc now. Will update status here once bf-7823 completes.
maria: thanks all :thumbsup:
